items.summary: Recommendation: maintain containment-only execution and authorize no spend, billing changes, monetization expansion, or new queue work. Amazon revenue evidence is limited to 2026-09-21: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission; the income is unattributed and cannot support site revenue, margin, ROI, payback, or forecasts. AI usage from 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-29 cost $947.39859535 across 5,289 calls, but it cannot be compared to one revenue day or treated as contribution-margin loss. Infrastructure spend, fixed costs, budgets, affiliate costs, and other variable costs are unknown. Continue only the existing period-aligned finance reconciliation and deployed-work measurement. The minimum finance artifact is a dated site/content ledger matching provider earnings, AI cost, infrastructure cost, affiliate cost, and other allocable variable costs to the same period, plus an approved learning threshold for cost-to-learn. Preserve the existing parked-site readiness work as non-financial containment; do not create a duplicate work item.
